canonical_outcomes.outcome: Separate what data identify from what an estimator computes and justify limiting arguments.
canonical_outcomes.evidence: Different projection, valid-moment and quasi-likelihood targets; exact asymptotic expansion and observationally equivalent policy set.
canonical_outcomes.limit: Does not assess every nonregular rate or extremum theorem.

canonical_outcomes.outcome: Derive linear estimators and choose inference appropriate to dependence and heterogeneity.
canonical_outcomes.evidence: Normal-equation target, unit-level score uncertainty and exact overlap covariance.
canonical_outcomes.limit: No full GLS efficiency proof or generic cluster/HAC estimator is required.

canonical_outcomes.outcome: Derive moment-based estimators and evaluate instrument relevance and validity.
canonical_outcomes.evidence: Valid external and invalid lag moments with nonzero first stages; local Wald effect and observational equivalence.
canonical_outcomes.limit: Weak-IV inversion, overidentified J tests and nonlinear GMM remain for Form B/project.

canonical_outcomes.outcome: Estimate nonlinear models and distinguish functional-form identification from causal identification.
canonical_outcomes.evidence: Global scalar Poisson quasi-likelihood optimum and robust log-mean variance under a finite non-Poisson law; target distinct from beta.
canonical_outcomes.limit: Binary APE, selection likelihood and moving-support inference are not claimed covered.

canonical_outcomes.outcome: Evaluate within-unit identification and dynamic-panel assumptions.
canonical_outcomes.evidence: Time-constant effect removal, transformed residual endogeneity, correct whole-unit repetition and explicit failure of a prior-outcome instrument.
canonical_outcomes.limit: This covers within/lag-information reasoning, not a complete autoregressive dynamic-panel coefficient theorem, attrition or CRE equivalence.

canonical_outcomes.outcome: Design and evaluate interventions with appropriate estimands and assignment mechanisms.
canonical_outcomes.evidence: Fixed-population interference exposures and exact assignment expectation; global sharp-null orbit and its difference from a weak null.
canonical_outcomes.limit: Power/sample-size planning and general attrition/encouragement inference remain outside this form.

canonical_outcomes.outcome: Defend counterfactual trends and handle treatment timing and heterogeneous effects.
canonical_outcomes.evidence: Conditional parallel trends, no anticipation, target composition, heterogeneous cell effects and an explicit coupled trend sensitivity.
canonical_outcomes.limit: This is two-period timing, not a staggered-adoption event-study estimator; deeper timing diagnostics reserved.

canonical_outcomes.outcome: Evaluate local and comparative designs with transparent support and validity conditions.
canonical_outcomes.evidence: Fuzzy-cutoff support, continuity, monotonicity/exclusion and local-versus-global effects.
canonical_outcomes.limit: Local-polynomial bias correction, donor support and synthetic-control fitting remain for Form B/project.

canonical_outcomes.outcome: Analyze persistent and dependent economic series with model-specific inference.
canonical_outcomes.evidence: Known triangular VAR forecasts and a Gaussian innovation proof of exact overlapping-error covariance and normality.
canonical_outcomes.limit: No stable-AR coefficient asymptotic, unit-root/cointegration or GARCH moment exercise in this form.

canonical_outcomes.outcome: Connect economic models to data and distinguish calibration from identified estimation.
canonical_outcomes.evidence: Rank-one observable map, same full process law, admissible calibration curve and a sharp policy set under explicit invariance.
canonical_outcomes.limit: Simulation bias and dynamic Bellman/indirect-inference estimation reserved for Form B/project.

canonical_outcomes.outcome: Apply modern methods while preserving valid inference and honest model evaluation.
canonical_outcomes.evidence: Actual unequal-fold fitting, aggregation, nuisance-rate checks, family trimming and selection-aware testing.
canonical_outcomes.limit: Bayesian posterior computation, MCMC and lasso deliberately not claimed assessed here.

canonical_outcomes.outcome: Independently audit a complete empirical paper and defend methodological choices.
canonical_outcomes.evidence: A complete compact synthetic report dossier: raw versions/units, branch provenance, inferential selection, information boundary, target composition and a scored defensible conclusion.
canonical_outcomes.limit: This is a hand-solvable synthetic audit, not executed replication of a real empirical paper; a complete open-resource empirical reproduction belongs to the project.

mandatory_scope_refinement.status: Resolved in final author contract; frozen proposal preserved
mandatory_scope_refinement.finding: The cutoff input specified local type masses/potential-type law, while the task called the weighted effects global ATEs. Local facts alone do not define a full-population global effect.
mandatory_scope_refinement.required_author_text: Define running score R uniformly distributed on[-1,1], independent of principal type, with eligibility Z=1{R>=0}. Types always/complier/never have population probabilities(1/5,3/5,1/5), and their stated potential outcomes are constant across the entire score support in each of the two complete teaching worlds. Receipt is1 for always, Z for compliers,0 for never. Outcomes follow consistency and exclusion. This explicit full-population extension makes the two global ATEs3 and14/5 well-defined and preserves every displayed local/observed numerical anchor. State that this score-invariant type law is an additional construction, not inferred from cutoff continuity.
